name: Westmoreland County, VA
findings: Westmoreland County has 51 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Westmoreland County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Westmoreland County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
